new_processes.name: Internal job opening referral
new_processes.definition: Passing on internal job postings and suggesting candidates for them.

new_processes.name: Desk turret set-up
new_processes.definition: Collecting turret IDs so desk staff can customize their trading turrets.

new_processes.name: Engineering subcontractor payment terms
new_processes.definition: Negotiating and clarifying the compensation basis for an engineering subcontractor under project services agreements.

new_processes.name: Online platform outage window coordination
new_processes.definition: Coordinating which products stay up and when they are suspended around the online trading platform outage window.

new_processes.name: Retail transaction charge discussion
new_processes.definition: Discussing the per-MW charge applied to retail transactions between trading desks.

new_processes.name: Project equipment delivery schedule
new_processes.definition: Circulating owner-supplied equipment delivery dates and corrections for a power project.

new_processes.name: Transmission pricing update
new_processes.definition: Telling the desk new transmission prices, losses treatment and booking rules.

new_processes.name: Counterparty hosted trip scheduling
new_processes.definition: Deciding who attends counterparty-hosted trips and updating the desk schedule.

new_processes.name: Intern paper review
new_processes.definition: Reviewing an intern's report and giving feedback before submission.

new_processes.name: Term deal opportunity pitch
new_processes.definition: A counterparty pitches a term gas transaction with value split and credit risk and asks for interest.
